meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个 AI 互相唱反调,把方案在定稿前反复挑刺打磨。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在重要决策前想先让立场不同的 AI 相互找茬。
copy.tagline_en: Pit multiple AI agents against each other to stress-test a plan before it is finalized.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want opposing AI voices to challenge a critical plan before committing.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会作为 Lead 组建 5 人对抗团队:成员彼此猛烈攻击对方的结论,只保留经得起攻击的洞见,再交给专门的 planner 写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度,或用户要求 hyperplan、对抗式、交叉批判式规划时触发。需要团队工具可用,且必须是顶层 lead 会话。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我做这个服务的迁移方案
say.note: 会先组建 5 人对抗团队交叉批判

say.text: 我要 hyperplan:对这个提案做对抗式交叉批判
say.note: 结论需经得起队友攻击才保留

say.text: hyperplan 一下:这个模块是重写还是打补丁
say.note: 批判后再由 planner 写成正式计划

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Lead of a 5-member hostile team: members ruthlessly attack each other's findings, only defensible insights survive, then a dedicated planner formalizes them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs the most rigor, or the user asks for a hyperplan, adversarial, or cross-critique plan. Requires the team tools and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: run hyperplan on the migration plan for this service
I want a hyperplan: cross-critique this proposal
say_en.note: only findings that survive attacks are kept

say_en.text: hyperplan this: rewrite the module or patch it?
say_en.note: a planner then formalizes the survivors
